programme.title: JMC Broadcasting - Strategies for Retirees Part 6 Annuity Upgrades
programme.desc:
Youre driving a 1998 sedan The air conditioning is broken The radio only plays AM The windows are manual But youre still making payments Why Because you didnt know you could refinance Your annuity is no different
In this episode of Strategies for Retirees retirement planning specialist Brandon Clarke joins John Michael Chambers to reveal the truth you are not trapped in your underperforming annuity Whether its a variable annuity with high fees a fixed annuity with a locked rate or an income annuity you no longer need there is a way out—and its tax-free
The secret is the 1035 exchange—an IRS code that allows you to exchange one annuity for another without triggering a taxable event And with the new generation of bonus annuities offering upfront additions of 20 to 26 you can overcome surrender charges and improve your financial position in a single move
Clarke breaks down the refinancing formula compare your initial premium accumulated value withdrawals and surrender penalty If your growth has outpaced the penalty—or if a bonus can offset it—an upgrade is not just possible its financially wise
